_doc: Throwables and fire (ADR-0057). A throwable's equip: noise = the Stimuli loudness (m) of where it lands (kind 'distraction': the Hollowed go to look there, not at the thrower; wildlife bolt at their bolt_loudness); throw_speed = [tap, full charge] launch speed (m/s), charge_time = seconds of holding the attack button to reach full (PlayerEquipment ThrowHand). A molotov is lit before it is thrown (needs_light: an igniter in the pack, a lighter or a torch; the attack button lights it, the next throws it), its rag burns fuse seconds in hand before it bursts there, and it shatters into the ground fire named by ground_fire (data/config/fire.json). An unlit one thrown just breaks.
